gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto X part 2 records, with the common part 1 status records for Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted. The same Japanese name is Preservation for the status and Conservation for passives 150402/150502. Support skills, zero allied damage, conditional Unbreakable conversion, reflection, and unknown Base Power increase are retained.

stageName.text: Sisyphus Department Store B, 3F: Le Noir Maison

lead.text: These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted, using renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus damage on one target to reduce actions. Distinguish Flannel gaining Preservation when hit while Shielded from the Maison reflecting damage during defense.

listLead.text: These enemies build Preservation and Le Noir: Worsted for renewed Shields and conditional Unbreakable Coins. Focus one enemy to reduce actions. Distinguish Count gained when the body is hit while Shielded from the other enemy's damage reflection during defense.

statNote.text: Covers Canto X Route B 3F. Flannel: Lv. 46, 541 HP, base Defense Level 48; Maison du Noir: Lv. 45, 266 HP, base Defense Level 47. Both start with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count. Excludes B2F versions and regular-enemy stats. Customer Level determines dungeon Identity levels; Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Team size is up to 12.

skillNote.text: Listed Power excludes Preservation, Tremor, and Defense Level differences. All Unbreakable conversion is conditional, so no fixed icons are shown. The Base Power increase from a Defense Level advantage of at least 5 in Fabric Density Disparity is unknown. Unfilled skill slots are omitted; changes between regular patterns and Count-based skills are not presented as a fixed sequence.

priorities.0.text: Focus attacks on an enemy you can finish, such as the Maison, to reduce actions.

priorities.1.text: Check Preservation Potency and Count separately. Prepare for conditional Unbreakable conversion at 3 Potency.

priorities.2.text: During the Maison's Stamping [Reverb], watch for reflection from small attacks against its Shield.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The Shield keeps returning despite repeated chip damage

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Le Noir: Worsted grants a fresh Shield every turn according to its stacks. Flannel also gains Preservation Count when hit while Shielded. Focus one enemy at a time, or break the Shield and deal substantial HP damage that turn.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Tremor and damage remain after a clash win

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Your purchasing rights, please? and Disqualifying defects, all over make the last Coin Unbreakable at 3 or more Preservation Potency. Flannel's Stamping also makes every Coin Unbreakable when consuming at least 10 Count. Winning does not stop everything; check the clasher's HP and Tremor.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Attacking the Maison damages my Sinner

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: During Stamping [Reverb], attacking while its Shield remains returns damage equal to Preservation Potency × Fabric stacks. Avoid careless repeated low-damage multi-hit attacks; concentrate enough damage to finish through the Shield or handle another enemy first.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: Where does the 4 Atk Weight For Conservation skill go?

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: It is support used on enemy allies, dealing 0 direct damage. Do not confuse it with an area attack against Sinners. It strengthens Preservation, defense, and Fabric, so check buffs afterward before assigning clashes.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare Customer Level and enough damage to finish a chosen enemy

phases.0.steps.0.text: Shop toward Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire. Lv. 51 is reachable at this point. Raising only outside Identity levels does not change dungeon levels.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Enemies take ×1.5 Sloth damage. Flannel also takes ×1.25 Lust; the Maison takes ×1.2 Blunt. Bring effective attacks and strong clashes. Both resist Slash at ×0.8.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Starts with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count and 5 Fabric. Potency and Count grow through different effects, so check both numbers separately.

phases.1.title.text: Clash with regular skills and focus on enemies you can finish

phases.1.steps.0.text: Clash with Your purchase history, please?, Your price range, please?, and similar skills to prevent extra on-hit Preservation and Tremor. On-use Count gains remain after winning.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Send spare attacks to a target you can finish, such as the lower-HP Maison. Avoid small attacks spread across everyone that only chip at Shields.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Flannel gains 1 Preservation Count when hit while Shielded. Concentrate damage to remove the Shield quickly and continue into HP.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Both enemies normally have Stagger Thresholds at 0 HP. Do not plan around an early Stagger from chip damage; use clashes and kills to stop actions.

phases.2.title.text: Check support targets and buffs after consumption

phases.2.steps.0.text: Reinforce Fabric and For Conservation support enemy allies and deal 0 damage to them. They raise Flannel's own Defense Level and the target's Charge Count. Preservation, as a special Charge, is affected too.

phases.2.steps.1.text: If the target's Charge Count is capped, it gains 3 Defense Level Up and 5 Le Noir: Worsted next turn. Decide where to focus attacks before that target grows stronger.

phases.2.steps.2.text: For Conservation refills Count to 10 if lower and gives the user Fragile according to the amount added. It consumes all Count after attacking, so a low remaining Count afterward does not guarantee safety.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Every 3 Preservation Count consumed cumulatively grants 1 Fabric; every 10 grants 1 Potency. Consumption strengthens defense and later skills, so avoid letting support repeat through a long battle.

phases.3.timing.text: At least 3 Preservation Potency or high Count

phases.3.title.text: Check Unbreakable conditions and assign strong clashes

phases.3.steps.0.text: Your purchasing rights, please? and Disqualifying defects, all over gain +1 Coin Power per 6 combined Preservation Count and target Tremor (max 2). At 3 or more Preservation Potency, the last Coin also becomes Unbreakable.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Stamping [Flannel] consumes up to 15 Preservation Count for a Shield equal to (Count consumed × 2)% max HP, lasting through next turn. Consuming at least 10 grants +2 Coin Power and makes all three Coins Unbreakable.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Stamping also converts to Tremor - Decay and triggers Tremor Burst. Use a strong clash to lower Coin Power; avoid low-HP or high-Tremor targets. It has no 80% damage reduction on a clash win.

phases.3.steps.3.text: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, more Tremor is inflicted. A target with lower Defense Level also takes extra damage from the level gap. Check actual Power predictions and target HP.

phases.4.title.text: Recognize reflection and focus damage to the finish

phases.4.steps.0.text: The Maison's Stamping [Reverb] is a Defense Skill. When attacked while Shielded, it returns damage equal to Preservation Potency × Le Noir: Worsted stacks. Avoid repeatedly chipping at a Shield that remains intact.

phases.4.steps.1.text: If enough damage is available, finish through the Shield. Redirect Sinners endangered by reflection to clashes against another enemy and limit unnecessary damage.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Focus damage on remaining enemies to stop repeated Shield and Fabric buffs. Even when Count falls, keep checking accumulated Potency and conditional Unbreakable conversion.

mechanics.0.effect.text: A special Charge starting at 1 Potency / 0 Count, with a base Count cap of 20. Lose 1 Count at Turn End; effects changing Charge Potency or Count also apply. Every 3 Count cumulatively consumed grants 1 Fabric, and every 10 grants 1 Preservation Potency. At 3 or more Potency, Count cap +5.

mechanics.0.response.text: Spending Count still builds Potency. Check both and defeat enemies one at a time before the fight drags on.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 15. Per 5 stacks, maximum Speed −1, Offense Level +1, and Defense Level +1. Lose 1 at Turn End. Gain 5 at Stage Start, then a Shield equal to stacks% of max HP each Turn Start.

mechanics.1.response.text: Focus damage with renewed Shields and defense buffs in mind. The Maison's reflection uses these stacks too.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Defense Level −1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Tremor Burst raises Stagger Threshold by Potency; lose 1 Count at Turn End.

mechanics.2.response.text: Conversion from regular Tremor also lowers defense. Assign strong skills to Sinners with less Tremor to avoid Stagger and increased damage taken.

mechanics.3.effect.text: If enemy Defense Level exceeds the target's, damage +3% per level of difference (max 30%). At a gap of at least 5, Base Power also rises by an unknown amount. At 3/5 or more Preservation Potency, inflicted Tremor Potency +1/+2.

mechanics.3.response.text: Check predicted Power and current defense and Tremor rather than judging only from base values.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Raised by department-store shopping with eyeballs; determines dungeon Identity levels.

mechanics.4.response.text: Prepare for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire.

warnings.0.text: Flannel's Quality Preservation and the Maison's Inspection Preservation are distinct. Preservation Count gained from taking hits while Shielded belongs to Flannel.

warnings.1.text: Reinforce Fabric and For Conservation support the enemy team. Atk Weight alone does not make them area attacks against Sinners.

warnings.2.text: The Maison's Stamping [Reverb] reflects damage from attacks against its Shield while defending. It differs from Flannel's Attack Skill.

warnings.3.text: All Unbreakable conversion is conditional. Distinguish the 3 Potency condition from Stamping consuming at least 10 Count.

warnings.4.text: Extra Base Power from Fabric Density Disparity and the exact action-switching order are unconfirmed. Check actual skills and predicted Power.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Customer Lv. 50 or higher and Sapphire. Outside Identity levels do not carry into the dungeon.

preparation.1.text: Bring high Sloth damage and strong clashes. Lust works well against Flannel and Blunt against the Maison.

preparation.2.text: Prepare HP recovery for Tremor and Unbreakable damage. Check the target's Blunt, Envy, and Sloth resistances too.

roles.0.reason.text: Concentrate on the chosen enemy to reduce actions before another Shield is gained.

roles.1.reason.text: Beat skills strengthened by Preservation and Tremor to limit extra Tremor and Preservation gains.

roles.2.name.text: HP recovery and taking Blunt hits

roles.2.reason.text: Recover damage from conditional Unbreakable Coins and Maison reflection.

units.0.notes.1.text: Defense is the base value before Fabric, SP, and skill effects.

units.1.notes.0.text: The 3F add, distinct from the B2F version with 327 HP.

skills.0.response.text: The on-use +2 Count remains after winning, but additional on-hit gains and Tremor can be prevented. A Shield also raises damage, so take the clash.

skills.3.effects.4.text: - If the target's Charge Count reaches its cap, grant 3 Defense Level Up and 5 Le Noir: Worsted next turn

skills.3.response.text: Support used on enemy allies, dealing 0 direct damage. Raises Flannel's own defense and the target's Charge Count. Check the target and Preservation values, then concentrate enough damage to finish an enemy.

skills.4.effects.0.text: Used on allies; damage to allies is fixed at 0

skills.4.effects.1.text: [On Use] Final Power +2 per 4 Tremor on the target (max 6)

skills.4.effects.2.text: [On Use] At 3 or more Preservation Potency, convert all Coins to Unbreakable Coins

skills.4.effects.6.text: Ⅰ [On Hit] Gain 2 Defense Level Up this turn and next turn

skills.4.effects.8.text: - If the target's Charge Count reaches its cap, grant 3 Defense Level Up and 5 Le Noir: Worsted next turn

skills.4.response.text: Despite 4 Atk Weight, it supports enemy allies and deals 0 direct damage to them. Refills Count, uses it for support, then consumes it all. Consumption builds Fabric and Potency; avoid a prolonged fight.

skills.5.response.text: A regular two-Coin Blunt skill. On-use Count gains remain, but clash to prevent extra on-hit gains and Tremor.
